title: LogEvent
description: Represents a single log event produced by an application, service, host, or device and ingested by a logging platform.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the log event occurred at the source.

observed_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the log event was observed by the collection pipeline.

severity.description: Severity level of the log event.

severity_number.description: Numeric severity following the OpenTelemetry severity scale (1-24).

body.description: Raw or rendered message body of the log event.
body.example: Order checkout failed: payment provider returned HTTP 502

service.description: Logical service or application that produced the log event.

host.description: Host, container, or instance identifier that produced the log event.

environment.description: Deployment environment that produced the log event.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier correlating this log event to a trace.

span_id.description: Span identifier within the trace correlated to this log event.

attributes.description: Structured key/value attributes attached to the log event.

source.description: Origin of the log event in the collection pipeline.

stream.description: Logical log stream, index, dataset, or table the event belongs to.
